_comment: 1-GPU job that deliberately burns the GPU for ~4 minutes, so `aihc-job watch <jobId>` has real load to show. Used to verify the monitoring path end to end without spending a training run.
name: gpu-load-probe
command:
python -c "import torch,time;print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.get_device_name(0), flush=True);a=torch.randn(12288,12288,device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16);t=time.time();n=0
while time.time()-t<240:
    a=(a@a)/128; n+=1
torch.cuda.synchronize();print('matmuls', n, flush=True)"
